mapper.sql: CONCAT( COUNT(*), ':', COALESCE(MAX(version), 0), ':', COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(updated_at)) * 1000)::BIGINT, 0), ':', COALESCE(MD5(STRING_AGG(fingerprint, ',' ORDER BY fingerprint)), MD5('')) )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ( SELECT i.version AS version, i.updated_at AS updated_at, CONCAT_WS( '|', i.id::TEXT, i.status, i.title, i.version::TEXT, COALESCE(mp.display_name, ''), COALESCE(mp.photo_object_key, ''), COALESCE(mp.appearance_text, ''), COALESCE(mp.last_seen_location_text, ''), COALESCE(mp.last_seen_at::TEXT, '') ) AS fingerprint FROM incident i LEFT JOIN missing_person mp ON mp.incident_id = i.id WHERE i.id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ) source

SELECT
FROM ( SELECT area.version AS version, area.updated_at AS updated_at, CONCAT_WS('|', area.id::TEXT, area.status, area.version::TEXT, area.color_token) AS fingerprint FROM search_area area JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = area.operational_period_id WHERE op.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND area.area_level = 'OVERALL' AND area.status = 'ACTIVE' ) source

SELECT
FROM ( SELECT area.version AS version, area.updated_at AS updated_at, CONCAT_WS('|', area.id::TEXT, area.status, area.version::TEXT, area.color_token) AS fingerprint FROM search_area area JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = area.operational_period_id WHERE op.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND area.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND area.status != 'CANCELLED' ) source

SELECT
FROM ( SELECT sp.version AS version, sp.updated_at AS updated_at, CONCAT_WS('|', sp.id::TEXT, sp.status, sp.version::TEXT) AS fingerprint FROM search_path sp JOIN duty_shift ds ON ds.id = sp.duty_shift_id JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = ds.operational_period_id WHERE op.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ds.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ) source

SELECT
FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT marker.id, GREATEST(marker.version, COALESCE(photo.version, marker.version)) AS version, GREATEST(marker.updated_at, COALESCE(photo.updated_at, marker.updated_at)) AS updated_at, CONCAT_WS( '|', marker.id::TEXT, marker.status, marker.version::TEXT, COALESCE(photo.id::TEXT, ''), COALESCE(photo.status, ''), COALESCE(photo.version::TEXT, '') ) AS fingerprint FROM marker LEFT JOIN photo ON photo.marker_id = marker.id AND photo.status = 'ATTACHED' WHERE marker.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND marker.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND marker.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'UPDATED') ) source
